strengths: Opening scene (bill, leftover cash, chase) instantly frames the visitor problem.
Visitor tips and FAQ answer practical pay-and-leave questions.

issues.location: Why Service Is Treated as Included (tax + training paragraphs after Fact/Interpretation)
issues.problem: The middle section stacks pricing, omotenashi, exits, tax labeling, and staff training without a clear beat change, so readers can lose the through-line before exceptions.
issues.suggestion: Shorten or relocate the tax/training material; keep one clean close after the Fact/Interpretation block before moving on.

issues.problem: “Many visitors to Japan notice one unusual thing.” is a soft stock hook.
issues.suggestion: Lead with the cash-on-table or chase scene in the first line.
